value.rationale: The paper supplies an invariant two-dimensional trapezium with interpolating interval exchanges without quantifying its least-period geometry. The new classification answers the natural finite invariant-area question for every rational translation: exactly \(p+1\) observed least periods and a universal angle-independent area spectrum with half-weight endpoints. It simultaneously describes every horizontal periodicity phase and proves irrational minimality/unique ergodicity. The natural exact invariant needs no downstream theorem, and its geometric integration is more substantive than arbitrary parameter tabulation.
